# hetu - Structural Handling of Finnish Personal Identity Numbers

### Introduction

`hetu` is an R package for structural handling of identification codes
used in Finland, most importantly Finnish flavour of national
identification numbers, the Finnish personal identity codes (in Finnish:
henkilötunnus (hetu), in Swedish: personbeteckning). Some functions can
also be used with Finnish Business ID numbers (in Finnish: yritys- ja
yhteisötunnus (y-tunnus), in Swedish: företags- och organisationsnummer
(FO-nummer)) and Finnish Unique Identification Numbers (FINUID, in
Finnish: sähköinen asiointitunnus (SATU), in Swedish: elektronisk
kommunikationskod).

The syntax in this package aims to be, when convenient, similar with
another package specializing in national identification numbers: the
[sweidnumbr](https://github.com/rOpenGov/sweidnumbr) R package for
working with Swedish personal identity numbers and corporation identity
numbers.

### Installation

Install stable version from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages(hetu)
```

Alternatively, use `devtools` package to install the latest development
version from GitHub:

``` r

devtools::install_github("rOpenGov/hetu")
```

Development version can be also installed using the
[r-universe](https://ropengov.r-universe.dev):

``` r

# Enable this universe
options(repos = c(
  ropengov = "https://ropengov.r-universe.dev",
  CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
))
install.packages("hetu")
```

### Loading the package and accessing the tutorial

Loading the package in R command line:

``` r

library(hetu)
```

A simple example of printing a table containing data from 2 imaginary
personal identity codes:

``` r

example_hetu <- c("010101-0101", "111111-111C")
hetu(example_hetu)
#>          hetu    sex p.num ctrl.char       date day month year century
#> 1 010101-0101 Female   010         1 1901-01-01   1     1 1901       -
#> 2 111111-111C   Male   111         C 1911-11-11  11    11 1911       -
#>   valid.pin
#> 1      TRUE
#> 2      TRUE
```

The package can also be used to check the validity of Finnish Business
IDs (Yritys- ja Yhteisötunnus, or Y-tunnus for short):

``` r

example_ytunnus <- c("5996039-9", "5619117-6", "6095515-9")
bid_ctrl(example_ytunnus)
#> [1] TRUE TRUE TRUE
```

A tutorial is included with the package and can be viewed with
vignette-function:

``` r

vignette("hetu")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bid_ctrl()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/bid_ctrl.md)
  : Check Validity of Finnish Business ID (Y-tunnus)
- [`hetu()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/hetu.md) :
  Generic Extraction Tool for Finnish Personal Identity Codes
- [`hetu_control_char()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/hetu_control_char.md)
  : Calculate Control Character for Personal Identity Code
- [`hetu_diagnostic()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/hetu_diagnostic.md)
  [`pin_diagnostic()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/hetu_diagnostic.md)
  : Diagnostics Tool for Personal Identity Codes
- [`is.diagnostic()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/is.diagnostic.md)
  : Is an Object from Class "diagnostic"?
- [`pin_age()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/pin_age.md)
  [`hetu_age()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/pin_age.md) :
  Extract Age from Personal Identity Code
- [`pin_ctrl()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/pin_ctrl.md)
  [`hetu_ctrl()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/pin_ctrl.md)
  : Check Validity of Personal Identity Code
- [`pin_date()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/pin_date.md)
  [`hetu_date()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/pin_date.md)
  : Extract Date of Birth from Personal Identity Code
- [`pin_sex()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/pin_sex.md)
  [`hetu_sex()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/pin_sex.md) :
  Extract Sex from Personal Identity Code
- [`plot(`*`<diagnostic>`*`)`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/plot.diagnostic.md)
  : Plotting method for diagnostic class objects
- [`rbid()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/rbid.md) :
  Generate Random Finnish Business ID's (Y-tunnus)
- [`rpin()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/rpin.md)
  [`rhetu()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/rpin.md) :
  Generate Random Personal Identity Codes
- [`satu_control_char()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/satu_control_char.md)
  : Finnish Unique Identification Number Control Character Calculator
- [`satu_ctrl()`](https://ropengov.github.io/hetu/reference/satu_ctrl.md)
  : Check Validity of Finnish Unique Identification Number (SATU)
